title: Astrophotography
description: Photos I have taken of space stuff.

andromeda.jpeg.alt: The Andromeda Galaxy, a large spiral of grey-blue light with a bright core, crossed by dark dust lanes and surrounded by stars
andromeda.jpeg.caption: Andromeda Galaxy (M31), with its companion galaxies M32 and M110. Nikon D5600 on an iOptron Sky Guider Pro, processed in StarTools.

na-nebula.jpg.alt: Red glowing gas filling the frame, with a dark lane of dust curving through the middle and thousands of stars
na-nebula.jpg.caption: North America Nebula (NGC 7000) in Cygnus. Nikon D5600 on an iOptron Sky Guider Pro, processed in StarTools.

NorthAmerica_processed_v3 - claude.jpg.alt: Red glowing gas filling the frame, with a dark lane of dust curving through the middle and thousands of stars
NorthAmerica_processed_v3 - claude.jpg.caption: North America Nebula (NGC 7000) in Cygnus. Nikon D5600 on an iOptron Sky Guider Pro, processed by Claude.
